sections.text: Art glass spans from the 13th-century Gothic cathedral window to the individual studio artist working today. Three distinct traditions define the field: the monumental craft tradition of stained glass (architecture-scale, workshop production), the decorative object tradition (Gallé, Tiffany, Lalique — art applied to glass objects), and the studio glass movement (individual artists working with hot glass since 1962).
